title: Cheesy Chuck Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful bowl dish originating from Venezuela, featuring tender chuck roast and a rich, cheesy sauce.

ingredients.name: Chuck Roast
ingredients.notes: Choose a lean chuck roast for the best results

ingredients.name: Roast Bowl
ingredients.notes: A large, shallow bowl for serving

instructions: Season the chuck roast with salt and black pepper.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the chuck roast until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the roast to the preheated oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
While the roast cooks, heat a tablespoon of oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the beef broth and bring to a simmer. Cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Remove the roast from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Serve the sliced roast in the roast bowl with the cheesy sauce spooned over the top.
Sprinkle with shredded cheese and serve immediately.
